nodes.label: .`GET equipment lists the pieces with refined values, costs and the capacity`()
.`GET equipment of a player without pieces is an empty list`()
.`GET equipment never shows the pieces of another account`()
.`equip puts the piece on the hero and answers the whole list`()
.`equip on a taken slot sends the old piece back to the bag`()
.`equip moves a piece worn by another hero and leaves that slot empty`()
.`equip on a hero the player does not own is 409 HERO_NOT_OWNED and changes nothing`()
.`equip of a missing piece or of a piece of another account is 404 EQUIPMENT_NOT_FOUND`()
.`unequip empties the slot and keeps the piece`()
